## 👋 About

Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer with 17+ years of experience building scalable web applications, REST, GraphQL and gRPC APIs, and microservices on Amazon Web Services (AWS). For 4 years, technical lead and architect of Sur La Table's e-commerce platform (up to 2M monthly unique visitors): led the migration from Salesforce Commerce Cloud to React and a NestJS backend-for-frontend, integrated AI-powered search that increased online sales by at least 5%, and helped grow the team from 2 to 6 developers. Expert in TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js, React, Python, PostgreSQL, automated testing (Jest, Vitest, pytest) and CI/CD. Currently building open-source AI products with LLM agents and the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
